Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

manual_gate.open: preview/commit/cancel of Bezel Builder Full on the OpenMatrix9 window

limitations: Boolean=On is evaluated in the section frame: the finger rail is a ring on the same girdle, so the groove is the rail section swept along the outline. A non-ring target would need the 3-D CSG owner.
The committed Finger Rail body is an Insert alongside the notched ring; it carries the same om9.settings.bezel payload so a rebuild can find it.
The edge profile drives the corner shape only; the section parameters (height/top/base/dome/angle/chamfer) are explicit typed values.
